N001.policy_summary: Prioritize tech and economy, keep production moderate, expand safely, and prepare for ground transition.
N001.summary: Early game, around 3 minutes, with both sides having heavy economy and technology investment, moderate production, and no clear army composition yet. Continue developing your economy and technology, increase production, and strengthen your ground army. Maintain a defensive posture while expanding.
N001.title: Early Game Tech and Economy Foundation
N001.trigger_summary: Early game, around 3 minutes, with both sides having heavy economy and technology investment, moderate production, and no clear army composition yet.

N002.policy_summary: Strengthen ground forces, boost production, maintain economy/tech, expand, and gain vision with Observers.
N002.summary: Early-mid game, around 4-6 minutes, with both sides transitioning to a ground-oriented army. Opponent shows Marines, and you have Stalkers and Sentries. Continue strengthening your ground army, increase production, and maintain your economy and tech lead. Keep expanding and consider adding Observers for vision.
N002.title: Early-Mid Game Ground Transition
N002.trigger_summary: Early-mid game, around 4-6 minutes, with both sides transitioning to a ground-oriented army. Opponent shows Marines, and you have Stalkers and Sentries.

N003.policy_summary: Build a powerful ground army with tech, keep production and economy strong, and prepare for spell damage options.
N003.summary: Mid-game, around 9 minutes, with both sides having heavy production and tech. Opponent shows a ground army with Marines, Reapers, Marauders, and Medivacs. You have Colossus, Stalkers, Sentries, and Warp Prism. Continue strengthening your ground army, increase production, and maintain your economy and tech. Consider adding more Colossus or transitioning to High Templar for additional spell damage.
N003.title: Mid-Game Tech Army Assembly
N003.trigger_summary: Mid-game, around 9 minutes, with both sides having heavy production and tech. Opponent shows a ground army with Marines, Reapers, Marauders, and Medivacs. You have Colossus, Stalkers, Sentries, and Warp Prism.

N004.policy_summary: Consolidate ground forces, keep production and economy high, and adapt with spellcasters or mixed composition.
N004.summary: Late-midgame, around 10-12 minutes, with both sides having heavy production and tech. Opponent shows a ground army with Marines, Reapers, Marauders, and Medivacs. You have Colossus, Zealots, Stalkers, and Sentries. Continue strengthening your ground army, increase production, and maintain your economy and tech. Consider adding High Templar for Storm or transitioning to a more mixed composition if needed.
N004.title: Late-Midgame Consolidation
N004.trigger_summary: Late-midgame, around 10-12 minutes, with both sides having heavy production and tech. Opponent shows a ground army with Marines, Reapers, Marauders, and Medivacs. You have Colossus, Zealots, Stalkers, and Sentries.
